title: Financial Analyst- Billing
description:
**Financial Analyst\- Billing**


**Department: Tax \& Accounting \- Financial Reporting**


**Location: Pune, India**

  




**Role Overview**



As a Financial Analyst in our Pune, India office, you will play a key role supporting the Finance Senior Manager in helping to create a methodical approach for optimizing operational business processes to enhance efficiency but also perform daily tasks according to pre\-established guidelines to ensure the invoicing and billing reflects the correct transactions.

  


**Responsibilities:**


* Calculating sales compensation commissions and invoicing.
* Analyzing accounts and specialized reports, investigating discrepancies, validating calculations against compensation plan rules and providing decision\-making insights.
* Carrying out monthly accruals, reconciliations.
* Participating in process improvement projects and ensuring effective accounting operations and compliance with internal controls, policies, and regulations.
* Prepare reports and presentations \- regularly prepare and generate reporting and presentations for ad hoc internal reviews
* Dashboard/ MI maintenance and management – wrangle and retrieve large data sets for consolidation, illuminating standard reporting metrics within custom dashboards to promote transparency across all key stakeholders
* Process development and approach – assist the Senior Manager to collaborate with other key stakeholders and develop standardized team processes to develop and define "how we work"

  


**Required Qualifications**


* Analytical skills
* Good communication and consultation skills, both written and verbal in English
* Experience in sales compensation
* 4\-5 years of experience in accounting
* Familiarity with the accounting standards and a degree in Business Management/ Finance / Accounting or a related
* Change Management experience
* Advanced proficiency in MS Excel (including modeling, advanced formulas, pivot tables, macros etc.)
* An advantage if you have hands\-on proficiency in one or more of the following business intelligence, visualization, and advanced analytics tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, Snowflake, or other similar systems.)
* Experience in the EU/Global payments industry would be an advantage.
* Ability to work independently, rigorous, organized and disciplined
* Excels in team environment with the ability to collaborate and liaise with geographically distributed teams
* Self\-starter with 'can\-do' attitude, a service mindset, and proactive in responding to requests
* Professional, detail\-oriented, and organized, with outstanding follow\-up abilities
* Enthusiastic, with a strong desire to succeed

  


**About Convera**



Convera is the largest non\-bank B2B cross\-border payments company in the world. Formerly Western Union Business Solutions, we leverage decades of industry expertise and technology\-led payment solutions to deliver smarter money movements to our customers – helping them capture more value with every transaction. Convera serves more than 30,000 customers ranging from small business owners to enterprise treasurers to educational institutions to financial institutions to law firms to NGOs. Our teams care deeply about the value we bring to our customers, which makes Convera a rewarding place to work. This is an exciting time for our organization as we build our team with growth\-minded, result\-oriented people who are looking to move fast in an innovative environment. As a truly global company with employees in over 20 countries, we are passionate about diversity; we seek and celebrate people from different backgrounds, lifestyles, and unique points of view. We want to work with the best people and ensure we foster a culture of inclusion and belonging.


**We offer an abundance of competitive perks and benefits including:**


* Competitive salary
* Opportunity to earn an annual bonus.
* Great career growth and development opportunities in a global organization
* A flexible approach to work


There are plenty of amazing opportunities at Convera for talented, creative problem solvers who never settle for good enough and are looking to transform Business to Business payments. Apply now if you're ready to unleash your potential.

title: Financial Analyst II
description:
**About Avaya**
---------------



Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.



The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.



We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.



Learn more at https://www.avaya.com


**Job Information**
-------------------



Job Code: 99930463


Job Family: Finance


Job Function: Financial Planning \& Analysis

**About the Opportunity**
-------------------------



Global Revenue Accounting (GRA) is a specialized global team performing ASC 606 revenue accounting out of Pune. As a General Accountant II, you will serve as an integral Finance Partner to ensure seamless business continuity, safeguard our internal control environment, and maintain our operational cadence. This is an individual contributor role with direct exposure to high\-level finance leadership, as your reports and reconciliations directly impact the organization's final revenue and top line.

**About the Responsibilities**
------------------------------


* **Revenue Accounting \& ASC 606 Compliance:**


	+ Perform monthly revenue accruals and deferrals in strict adherence to ASC 606 requirements.
	+ Conduct regular project reviews with the APS finance team to align project and POC status with Revenue Guidelines and RAR.
	+ Execute monthly cut\-off procedures for Hardware (HW) and Software (SW) based on Incoterms and LAC details.
	+ Manage revenue allocation processes to determine accurate contract asset and liability positions.

* **Internal Controls \& SOX Governance:**


	+ Execute quarterly SOX controls and ensure timely closure during Quarter\-End Close (QEC).
	+ Address PWC audit inquiries, deal reviews, and contract modifications related to prior closes.

* **Reconciliations \& Financial Reporting:**


	+ Perform quarterly reconciliations to substantiate Revenue\-related Balance Sheet GL accounts (including ST \& LT Contract Assets, Contract Liabilities, and AR Adjustments).
	+ Prepare the Balance Sheet Review Deck, providing thorough Quarter\-over\-Quarter (QoQ) and Year\-over\-Year (YoY) variance explanations for Revenue GLs.
	+ Automate manual reporting processes to enhance close efficiency.
**Who we are looking for \-**
-----------------------------

* **Education:** Qualified CA, CIMA, M.Com, or MBA in Finance (or equivalent field). Bachelor's degree in Finance required.
* **Experience:** 5 to 10 years of hands\-on experience in global revenue accounting, statutory book closures, and ASC 606 standards.
* **Technical Skills:** Advanced MS Excel skills, strong financial analysis capabilities, and experience with Revenue Automation tools (RAR) and SOX controls.
* **Soft Skills:** Exceptional communication, strong logical problem\-solving skills, high attention to detail, and a collaborative "finisher" mindset.
* **Work Schedule:** Ability to stretch and work extended hours/weekends during quarterly close cycles to meet strict Close Calendar deadlines. No travel required.

title: Finance Executive - Billing
description:
**Job Description – Billing Executive**

**Position:** Billing Executive  
**Location:** Pune  
**Work Week:** 5 Days a Week  
**Industry:** MNC / Manufacturing  
**Experience:** 2–5 years preferred

**About the Role**

We are looking for a **Billing Executive** to manage customer billing activities and coordinate closely with internal teams and customers to ensure accurate and timely invoicing.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication skills, attention to detail, and preferably hands\-on experience with **QAD ERP** or a similar ERP system.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare and process **customer invoices** accurately and within defined timelines.
* Verify billing information against sales orders, delivery documents, pricing and other relevant records.
* Coordinate with **Sales, Operations, Logistics, Finance and Customer Service** teams for billing\-related requirements.
* Liaise with customers to resolve billing discrepancies, invoice queries and documentation requirements.
* Ensure timely submission of invoices through customer portals or other specified channels.
* Maintain proper billing records and supporting documentation.
* Track pending invoices, credit/debit notes and billing\-related issues.
* Assist in reconciliation of customer accounts and resolving outstanding billing differences.
* Generate billing\-related reports and provide updates to management.
* Follow company policies, internal controls and MNC\-standard processes.
* Ensure accuracy, confidentiality and compliance in all billing activities.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* Graduate in **Commerce, Finance, Accounting or a related discipline**.
* 2–5 years of experience in **customer billing / invoicing / order\-to\-cash activities**.
* **QAD ERP experience preferred.**
* Good working knowledge of **MS Excel**.
* Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
* Excellent **spoken and written English** with the ability to communicate confidently with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Good coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a structured MNC environment.
* Strong ownership and ability to meet billing deadlines.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

The candidate should be:

* **Customer\-focused and professional** in communication.
* Comfortable coordinating with multiple departments.
* Proactive in following up and resolving billing issues.
* Detail\-oriented with a strong sense of accountability.
* Comfortable working with ERP systems and process\-driven environments.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work with a **reputed MNC environment**.
* **5\-day working week**.
* Structured and professional work culture.
* Exposure to international customers and processes.
* Opportunities for learning and career growth.

Pay: ₹10,022\.57 \- ₹32,604\.56 per month

Work Location: In person
